runtime.scope: Synthetic monolith with real isolated MySQL/Redis and embedded mock telephony. No real SIP/RTP, public telephone numbers, PCM, ASR/LLM/TTS providers, production or paid supplier calls.
runtime.runtime_note: Functional tests and load probes run on the host JDK 21.0.9; the built image contains JRE 21.0.13. Identical Jar verified, but these are not container-runtime capacity measurements.

changes: Reject negative and integer-overflow provider quotas without allocating a voice tuple.
Measure the first useful LLM delta and first reviewed sentence only once; remove duplicate TTS connection timing.
Record platform-lock wait duration on timeout and interruption as well as successful acquisition.
Select persisted lowercase running campaigns in the binary-collated batch queue SQL.
Return the durable call identity/state from create and retry when the original command awaits confirmation; retain its immutable command and resource occupancy.
Add an opt-in conservative commit-interval saturation probe, campaign reconciliation and failure evidence retention without relaxing 500 CPS/500 in-flight gates.

Correct the 500-call probe to configure both application and synthetic gateway limits, extend the mock lifetime beyond ramp and 120-second load, enforce the minimum hold, and reject 501st-call quota overrun. Production defaults remain unchanged.

local_integration_environment_error.reason: The existing MySQL binlog tool image build requires repo.mysql.com, which is blocked by this environment network proxy. Test was not skipped; current-patch GitHub CI is required before merge.

functional_validation.regression_reproductions: Quota, useful-first-token, lock-timeout timing, campaign selection and both pending-confirmation HTTP cases failed against their previous implementation before passing with the corresponding fix.
functional_validation.tooling: 79 other Node checks and all 6 PBX checks passed; the PBX checks required the configured JDK 21 environment. Contract, compose, dependency policy, Spotless, resource formatting, phone measurement and message API client checks passed.

counting_method.cps: Unique tenant/call/attempt dial_command_accepted identities with primary identity evidence and independent post-commit JDBC bounds. A commit is guaranteed in a second only when both bounds fall in that second. Possible counts include every overlapped second. Empty seconds remain zero.
counting_method.window: 10 seconds warmup followed by 20 measured seconds for saturation; fixed same-host campaign fixtures and nonexhausted queued input; each load probe ran serially.
counting_method.legacy_cps: The two legacy 500 CPS gates retain their five-second event-created-at diagnostic counts and unchanged thresholds; these are not substituted for commit-time saturation proof.
counting_method.peak_interpretation: Observed per-second peak under the tested configuration. The experiment does not prove the system maximum or sustainable capacity. Missing commit evidence, failed drain, timeouts and short occupancy remain failures.
counting_method.ai: 500 actual IN_AI calls must precede a 120-second, 50-turns/second steady state. HTTP 200 means a call identity was created and is not proof of an admitted or connected call.

qualification_note: Functional fixes can be merged independently of capacity qualification; do not set production acceptance flags or reuse historical Jar measurements as current capacity.

metrics.scope: Preloaded number pool with real durable scheduling / real MySQL+Redis / embedded mock telephony. No real SIP, RTP, audio, cloud models or public numbers.

configuration.dial_cohort_sizing: fixed configured batch; live per-item token check
configuration.voice_callback_protocol: v1 for <=16; additive signed v2 for 17..64

commit_rate.counting: unique tenant/call/attempt durable acknowledgements; JDBC commit intervals, not created_at or HTTP acceptance
commit_rate.scope: observed saturation on this host/configuration; not a production limit or sustained capacity qualification

observed_synthetic_lifetimes.note: Includes real application hangup commands; unfinished calls are excluded from ended-age aggregates. Diagnostic only, not formal occupancy coverage.
